subject: Decision matrix: latency vs cost — next steps & procurement owners
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 02 May 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Decision matrix: latency vs cost — next steps & procurement owners

Hi Julia — thanks again for your time today. Quick recap + asks from our side: we covered the integration flow, observed throughput on the demo, and walked through Redwood deployment options (hosted API, Dedicated reserved capacity, Private VPC).

Recap bullets:
- Primary use case: clinician-facing summaries + search re-rank; expected peak concurrency ~30 qps, average request size ~300 tokens.
- Concern areas you raised: p95 latency target, unit economics compared to current provider, and procurement/infosec gating (SOC 2 evidence + PO terms).

Asks / clarifying questions (so we can build a proposal and mutual action plan):
1) Economic buyer and final approver for purchase (name & role).
2) Procurement/legal owner who will own redlines and typical PO terms (contacts).
3) Security contact for SOC 2 / encryption / data retention questions (we can share docs).
4) Latency target: do you have a p95 inference SLA target (e.g., <= 250ms) and is that for 1k token responses or your full profile (300–512 tokens)?
5) Cost guidance: what is your current acceptable unit cost (e.g., $/1k tokens) or budget bucket for the pilot?
6) Deployment preference: are you open to a Hosted API pilot or do you require Dedicated/Private from day one?

Next steps we propose:
- We will send a short mutual action plan and two pricing/SLA scenarios (hosted pilot vs dedicated pilot) for you to review.
- If you can confirm the names for economic buyer / procurement / security this week, Ben (cc'd) will set up a 30-min PO & security sync.

Attached: Redwood_post-demo-slides.pdf (demo recap) and a blank MAP_MedAffinity_v1.xlsx we can fill with owners/timelines.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick follow if helpful.

Best,

Subject: Re: Decision matrix: latency vs cost — next steps & procurement owners

Hi Ava — appreciate the clear recap. Answers below to your asks:

1) Economic buyer / approver: Tom Reynolds (CTO) — primary approver for platform spend.
2) Procurement/legal owner: Sandra Liu (Procurement Lead) — she'll own PO terms and scheduling with vendors.
3) Security: Raj Patel (Head of Security & Compliance) — will need SOC 2 Type II evidence and answers on data retention + encryption in transit + at rest.

4) Latency target: for our clinician UI a p95 inference of <= 300ms is acceptable for up to 512 token responses. We prefer p95 <= 250ms but can tolerate 300ms depending on cost.

5) Cost guidance: current provider runs around $0.06/1k tokens for our production model. Procurement will push for parity or better (target ~ $0.04–0.05/1k) for a pilot to be attractive.

6) Deployment preference: we'd prefer Dedicated or Private VPC for production because of data governance, but we are open to a short Hosted pilot (2 weeks) if it shortens procurement and you can show latency/cost realism and SOC 2 evidence.

Procurement timeline: Sandra indicated vendor questionnaire and legal review completed by ~May 20. Pilot kickoff aiming early June if things align. I attached our latest RFI (MedAffinity_RFI_v2.pdf) for your security and procurement review.

Thanks — Julia
Julia Park
Director of Product, Clinical Apps
MedAffinity

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Julia Park <julia.park@medaffinity.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Decision matrix: latency vs cost — next steps & procurement owners

Thanks Julia — super helpful. I've mapped stakeholders and proposed two pragmatic options below so procurement can see trade-offs up front. I'll also pull our SOC 2 package and a short pilot SOW for Sandra and Raj.

Proposed options (high-level):
- Option A — Hosted pilot (fastest path): 2-week pilot, run on Redwood hosted API, workload-shaped caching, expected p95 ~ 220–300ms depending on batching and cache hit rate, unit cost estimate: $0.04–0.06/1k tokens (pilot pricing to be confirmed). Minimal procurement overhead — standard SaaS MSA + PO.
- Option B — Dedicated / Private pilot (preferred for production): reserved GPU pool or VPC private control plane, expected p95 ~ 120–180ms, unit cost estimate higher (~$0.06–0.09/1k tokens) but gives stronger isolation and predictable throughput; procurement time longer (infra contract/infra addendum).

Questions for you to confirm so we can finalize the MAP and pricing:
- Please confirm the p95 floor you need for pilot (you mentioned 250ms as preferred). For proposal purposes we'll assume pilot target p95 <= 250ms at ~300 token avg and surface heavier options if you need <200ms.
- Can Sandra share any standard SLA/PO terms that we should match (e.g., liability caps / payment terms / required carrier insurance)?

Next steps:
1) Ben will send a short vendor pricing brief and SOC 2 bundle by EOD Tuesday.
2) Propose a 30-min sync between Sandra/Legal and Ben + Neha on Wed or Thu to kick off RFI answers + contract cadence.
3) We will share a draft pilot SOW (2-week scope) for your review.

Attached: MAP_MedAffinity_v1.xlsx (filled with the owners you provided) — please update if anything is off.

Best,
Ava

--
